rendered:
In the CD-based LDA of all the bacteria with BA@L-HGNRs, the discriminant factors together account for essentially all of the total variance. The first factor accounts for 99.9%[1] and the second for 0.1%[2]. The same split is printed on the axes of the score plot in Fig. 2[3] panel e: Factor 1 (99.9%)[4] and Factor 2 (0.1%)[5]. In this plot the clusters for the bacterial strains do not overlap.

The same figure has comparison LDAs with different splits: Factor 1 (98.9%) and Factor 2 (1.0%)[6] for the colorimetric outputs (panel g), and Factor 1 (99.0%) and Factor 2 (0.9%)[7] for the unmodified L-HGNRs (panel h).
